style: Photorealistic editorial photograph. Blue hour turning to first light: slate and cold stone, brass and amber light, weathered wood, iron, rope, leather, cedar, desert rock and open water. Natural, grounded and quiet, with a fine film grain and deep shadows. No faces, no readable text, no letters or numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame.

compositions.portrait: Vertical 9:16. The subject sits in the lower half; calm open sky or soft darkness fills the upper half for words.
compositions.landscape: Horizontal 16:9. The subject sits near the centre with room on both sides; the same light and scene as the vertical image.
